newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Atok rejects Sterling unit proposal.
newsitem.headline: Atok rejects Sterling unit proposal.

text.p: Atok Big Wedge Co Inc has decided to recommend to its board that it reject a proposal for a joint venture by a unit of Sterling Pacific Resources Inc of Canada, the Philippine Stock Exchange said in an advisory on Wednesday.
Sterling Pacific Resources Phils Inc proposed last month that it acquire an interest in Atok's mining rights by forging a joint venture, the bourse said.
The exchange said it was informed by the company that the Atok board has not acted on the proposal.

"The (Atok) management has decided to recommend its disapproval for the acquisition of an interest in our mining rights by means of a joint venture," the bourse quoted a statement sent by Atok to the exchange as saying.
